Name: Em's Goats
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
A new design and twelve colour options for the goats. Making them softer and more realistic-looking
It includes the goat, baby goat and Marnie's livestock shop icon
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative textures
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url][i]
[/i]
The different types are:
Saanen
SaanenBell
Alpine
Bagot
Boer
Guernsey
Toggerburg
Sable
Cape
Billberry
BlackNeck
GoldenGuernsey

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Goats CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

When buying a goat from Marnie, the type gets randomised and can be any of the twelve options
If you rather choose which colour you buy, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url]

Alternatively, you can choose ﻿"Em's Goats CP Config"
This allows you to choose one type for your farm with a config.json

The default is the [color=#e69138]Saanen[/color] goat. To choose a different type:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] in the goat mod folder
Replace "[color=#e69138]Saanen[/color]" with the name of the type you like
The choice you make also affects Marnie's shop icon
Save and close the file again, and you're all set!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

[i]Update 1.1 Included update keys and minor AT script fixes
Update 1.2 Both files can now be installed side by side
Update 1.3 Three new goats and several animation improvements[/i]
